author: WP18
summary: Alpha.1-era chapter on compiling CNA to WebAssembly: renderer admission, the exception model, threads, content in the virtual file system, save persistence, web networking topology and what a build proves. Several facts are stale at TARGET: the exception ABI is JS-lowered -fexceptions, Asyncify is on every CNA executable, a pthread ABI option exists, bundles can hold several renderers and CnaTests uses JSPI. Tutorials 81/124 and the network deep dive already covered persistence and networking; the build contract and evidence levels are on a new deep dive.

sections.heading: The toolchain changes the execution contract
Assets must cross the virtual-filesystem boundary
Networking is a different topology, not a transparent port

concepts.text: CNA has no separate JavaScript implementation: the web build compiles the same C++23 framework with Emscripten against SDL3's browser port.

The older text said configuration admits 24 identities on Emscripten and one configure packages exactly one; at TARGET the guards refuse the native GL profiles, the Windows-only identities and METAL, and CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERERS can link several browser renderers into one bundle.
tokens: One configure is not limited to one renderer
concepts.note: Corrected: multi-renderer bundles exist; no admitted-identity count is claimed.

concepts.section: The toolchain changes the execution contract
concepts.text: WEBGL2 is the default renderer under Emscripten and, like WEBGL1, is backed by EasyGL (built with EASYGL_EMSCRIPTEN_EXCEPTION_MODEL=JS); the link contract pins MIN/MAX_WEBGL_VERSION to the identity's version, while CANVAS, HTML_DOM and SVG_DOM are separate implementations.

concepts.section: The toolchain changes the execution contract
concepts.text: The older text said the web build uses native WebAssembly exceptions (-fwasm-exceptions); at TARGET every CNA-owned target and every consumer through CNA::BuildConfig uses JS-lowered exceptions (-fexceptions, -sDISABLE_EXCEPTION_CATCHING=0) plus a 1 MiB stack.

concepts.section: The toolchain changes the execution contract
concepts.text: Game::Run() logs an exception thrown before the loop and rethrows it, because on the web it would otherwise reach the page as a rejected promise with only an opaque exception pointer.

concepts.section: The toolchain changes the execution contract
concepts.text: The older text said the web build is single-threaded with no pthread support; at TARGET CNA_ENABLE_EMSCRIPTEN_THREADS (off by default) switches the whole application to the pthread ABI with OFFSCREEN_FRAMEBUFFER and WasmFS (to avoid a main-thread-proxied file system deadlocking background loads) and a separate SDL install, leaving cross-origin isolation to the host page.
concepts.note: Corrected: an opt-in threaded ABI exists.

concepts.section: The toolchain changes the execution contract
concepts.text: The older text said only one CnaTests configuration uses ASYNCIFY=1 for networking; at TARGET Asyncify is linked into every CNA-owned executable for blocking Game::Run() unless CNA_EMSCRIPTEN_ASYNCIFY is OFF (the C API wasm opts out), external apps link CNA::EmscriptenAsyncify, and CnaTests uses JSPI and EXIT_RUNTIME.
concepts.note: Corrected: Asyncify is an executable policy; tests use JSPI.

concepts.section: Assets must cross the virtual-filesystem boundary
concepts.text: A browser has no working-directory files: a file exists in Emscripten's virtual file system only if the page creates it or the linker packages it, and ContentManager looks only there.
tokens: a file exists there only if the page creates it or the linker packages it

concepts.section: Assets must cross the virtual-filesystem boundary
concepts.text: Exactly two CNA build sites use --preload-file (the 2D graphics demo and the sound demo, both Content@/Content); there is no project-wide asset manifest, --embed-file policy or custom shell file, so a successful link proves nothing about content.

concepts.section: Assets must cross the virtual-filesystem boundary
concepts.text: Saves are volatile on the web: StorageDevice resolves XDG_DATA_HOME/LOCALAPPDATA/HOME paths inside the in-memory virtual file system (not SDL's preference path, which the older text blamed), and CNA mounts no IDBFS and never calls FS.syncfs, so data survives the page but not a reload (reading; not executed).
concepts.note: Mechanism corrected (StorageDevice does not use SDL_GetPrefPath); conclusion confirmed. Issue already recorded as WP15-i014.

target.evidence: modules/storage/src/StorageDevice.cpp (EnsureStorageRoot); no IDBFS/syncfs in the TARGET tree

concepts.section: Assets must cross the virtual-filesystem boundary
concepts.text: Sharp Runtime's IsolatedStorage uses /save/.cna_isolated_storage on Emscripten, expects the application to mount IDBFS there and calls FS.syncfs when a stream closes; CNA's StorageDevice does not go through it and nothing in CNA mounts /save.

concepts.section: Networking is a different topology, not a transparent port
concepts.text: On Emscripten the ENet host binds the fixed port 61191 (the socket shim reports no ephemeral port; meaningful only for a Node relay), the joining side is rebuilt as an outbound-only client, and UDP discovery is compiled out.

concepts.section: Networking is a different topology, not a transparent port
concepts.text: The test-only suspension (JSPI at TARGET) lets polling yield for loopback tests but adds no listening sockets or discovery; network evidence must name the role and host, not only that ENet linked.
tokens: must name the role and the host

concepts.text: A completed Emscripten link proves the source closure is accepted and the renderers' symbols resolve, but not that content was packaged, saves persist, a frame was reached, WebGL shaders compiled in a browser, or the selected renderer displayed.
tokens: that generated WebGL shaders compiled in a browser

concepts.text: Bare Node is a poor substitute for a browser: DOM renderers need window and document, SDL-backed ones need browser services and WebGL needs a context, so 'window is not defined' or an SDL init failure means the wrong host, not a renderer result.

A reproducible web record names the CNA commit, emsdk version, renderer identity or set, ABI-changing options, target, the .html/.js/.wasm artifacts and every preload mapping, plus whether it was linked, run under Node or served over HTTP to a named browser (ascending levels); the HTML_DOM workflow pins emsdk 6.0.3.
tokens: Those are ascending levels, not synonyms

concepts.text: WebAssembly keeps the language and loses much of the process model; the hard porting work sits at the boundaries (host-owned loop, content in the virtual file system, persistence, a verdict that must leave the process).
tokens: a verdict that has to leave a process whose exit status nobody can observe

issues.text: CnaTests links -sJSPI=1 while, as a CNA-owned executable without CNA_EMSCRIPTEN_ASYNCIFY=OFF, it also receives -sASYNCIFY=1; its comment still describes a -fwasm-exceptions root ABI. Whether the two suspension settings conflict was not established.
